rows.en: Nngh… I'll leave none of them alive!

…!?

A time bomb, it's going to blow!

…!?

He's gone? Where? Search! Find Joji Yuki!!
He's escaped!! Treachery! Don't let him get away! After him!!
Until I defeat Marshal Armor, I can't let the likes of you take me down! Here I come!
That's far enough! Traitor, Joji Yuki!!
…!? Everyone!
Hahaha… Your traitorous assistants will be executed by Destron!
What!?
Mr. Yuki!
Mr. Yuki, don't worry about us, run!
Fufufu… Joji Yuki, if you want your assistants back, come to the hideout alone! Flyyy!
Wait! Damn… Destron!
Is it around here…?
Hoh… Looks like it wasn't a bogus address after all.
A Destron cyborg?
TV-Fly is the name! Shiro Kazami, my Hypno TV will make you do whatever I want! Flyyy!!
Whoa…
Damn… At this rate, he'll get me!!
Fool… My Hypno TV should work even on V3!
It's the footage from TV-Fly! Record Rider V3's movements on video.
Eeee!!

You're…!? Kamen Rider 1, no, 2…

…No, you're different. Who are you?
A demon of vengeance!
What!?
Destron cyborg, TV-Fly! You don't know my power? I'll make you feel the power of Riderman!
Blast it, insolent fool!
Tell Marshal Armor! Tell him I'll put an end to him, without fail! Here I come! Yaaah!!
Riderman… friend or foe?
Riderman… friend or foe?
Nngh… This fight ends here! V3, I've got your data!
Wait! Data? What are you talking about?
Wait! Data? What are you talking about?
Die! Shiro Kazami!
Die! Rider V3!
What are you doing, Taki! Stop it! Snap out of it!!
What are you doing, Taki! Stop it! Snap out of it!!
Ugh…
Taki… The Hypno TV got you? Damn you, Destron!
Taki… The Hypno TV got you? Damn you, Destron!
There you go, Taki… You'll be fine now.
There we go, Taki… That should do it. You're fine now.
Ow… My head's still pounding!
Hahaha… Taki, that was some rotten luck, huh?

You said it…

But those Destron guys… how did they know about my apartment?
That's just the kind of organization Destron is… Honestly, you can't let your guard down for a second.
Still, that man bothers me…

Yes…

He fights Destron… and Destron is after him. A strange guy!
Isn't he on our side?
Well… I hope so.

Marshal Armor…

Using the data the computer calculates from the video of Rider V3 filmed in the battle with TV-Fly, have Destron's science team create a cyborg superior to him!
Right, run it through the computer!
Sir…
UNFORTUNATELY… RIDER V3'S DATA… CANNOT BE PROCESSED BY COMPUTER…
That's ridiculous!?
PLEASE STOP THE COMPUTER… DANGER…
Whoa… This is bad, the computer has shorted out!

Nngh… Stop it, quickly! Put out the fire!

Not even our Destron Computer can analyze it… V3's abilities are fearsome!

Destron science team! Calculate that data, whatever it takes!

…!?

Fufufu… A moth flying straight into the flame, I see!
Marshal Armor! Riderman has come for revenge on behalf of Joji Yuki!

The only people who know this hideout…

are Destron's executives and the escaped Joji Yuki… Riderman! You're Joji Yuki!
That's right… Now, give me back my assistants!
Riderman, no, Joji Yuki! You're too late! Your assistants… I executed them with my own hands!
What!? I won't forgive you, Marshal Armor!

Rather than worry about others, you should worry about yourself! Joji Yuki, your execution begins anew!!

The likes of you are no match for Kamebazooka!
Wait, Marshal Armor! Are you running away!?
Riderman!?
Riderman!?
…!? Hey, are you all right?
…!? Hey, are you all right?
Traitor, Joji Yuki! Take my attack!
Nngh… Curse you, traitor Joji Yuki! Guoaaagh…
Is that the guy?
Indeed… He does look like a Kamen Rider, doesn't he?
Is that the man?
It's true! He looks like a Kamen Rider.

Are you all right!?

Leave this to me and get away!
I refuse! You're the one who should get away!

uncertain: U05224/U05229: TV-Fly's verbal tic フラ～イ rendered 'Flyyy!'.
U05268/U05270: the Destron Computer's katakana speech rendered in capitals to keep the robotic voice.
U05273: proverb 飛んで火にいる夏の虫 rendered as a moth flying into the flame.
